divergenceCodes.schema-version-collision: Both projects number this schema version; the fork's meaning is the per-wire line-jump flag. Upstream's reader accepts the number and migrates it as its own 58, so the file is mis-read with no diagnostic. This is the only silent case.
divergenceCodes.version-ahead-of-upstream: Above upstream's current version, so its reader refuses the file with UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION. Loud, and therefore safe — until upstream passes this number.
